about: Fill types and wall build-up of M015_L1, read by hand from the rectified photo (ADR-001 I2). Values carry source and certainty like the spec. Read from 3x crops of kontrola/fasada_M015_J_rektif.jpg with a 0.1 m grid (120 px/m), 2026-10-19; a clearly visible edge is 'meranie' (+-5 cm), anything hidden or inferred is 'odhad'.

source.note: fill types read by hand from the rectified photo S1 (crops 3x with metric grid), 2026-10-19; edges +-5 cm

thickness.note: render visible on the upper floor (green); thickness typological
historic solid brick front wall; not visible, total 0.45 m is ODHAD

wall.omietka_tehla_450.note: render + solid brick; the ground floor has a stone cladding (photo) that is NOT modelled - one wall zone per facade in I1/I2

transom.note: upper third hidden by an outside roller shutter (not modelled)

sash_bars.note: one horizontal glazing bar in each sash

win.2kr.note: white frames + roller shutters -> PVC window favourite; material NEOVERENÉ

sidelight.note: shop window right of the door, same frame

door.shop_sl.note: shop front: one leaf + fixed shop window + transom in one painted frame; aluminium NEOVERENÉ

leaves.note: two equal leaves with panels and glazed grilles

door.gate.note: the only two-leaf swing door favourite of the template is the garage double door; a gate with transom needs Tapir gap T7

sidelight_sill.note: display bottom at v = 0.78; the parapet is partly hidden by flowers

transom_h.note: transom bar at v = 2.19, the same over door and shop window

transom_bars.note: the transom over the door has two panes (bar at v = 2.66)

transom_bar_h.note: 2.66 - 2.19; meaning of the library parameter NEOVERENÉ

bar_h.note: as O5 (same window type, bar aligned)

simplifications.text: Kamenný obklad parteru (fotka) nie je v skladbe – stena má jednu skladbu po celej výške (jedna zóna na fasádu v I1/I2).
simplifications.proposal: v I3 rozdeliť zónu na parter s obkladom (cca 30 mm, ODHAD) a poschodie s omietkou

simplifications.text: Omietka sa do ostenia neotáča, aby otvor v líci = murovaný otvor = hrana na fotke (s otočením by bol otvor v líci o 2 cm menší z troch strán).

Ozdobný oválny nadsvetlík brány nie je modelovaný ako nadsvetlík; horné pole krídla (štýl panelu 14) ho len vizuálne nahrádza. Knižničná časť s nadsvetlíkom je dostupná len cez CreateDoors.libraryPartName, ktorého prvky Tapir nevie čítať/zapisovať (T7).
simplifications.proposal: prijať dočasne; po T7 prestavať na 'Double Door with Transom 27' + obdĺžnikový nadsvetlík s 1 priečkou

simplifications.text: Delenie nadsvetlíka (Divided Frame) prechádza nad dverami aj nad výkladom; na fotke je len nad dverami.
simplifications.proposal: prijať (rozdiel je v jednej priečke nad výkladom)
